meta.scope: Philippines Batch 4 — Disaster risk (typhoons, earthquakes), PEZA ecozones / investment, and major merchandise trade partners.

candidates.title: NDRRMC – National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council
candidates.publisher: National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council
candidates.description: Lead coordinating body for disaster risk reduction and management. Issues situational reports and compiles impact data on tropical cyclones, earthquakes and other hazards.
candidates.notes: Institutional core of the Philippine disaster-management system.

candidates.title: Natural hazard occurrence and impact statistics (typhoons, earthquakes, etc.)
candidates.description: Compiled statistics on fatalities, injuries, affected population, damaged houses and economic losses from tropical cyclones, earthquakes and other natural hazards. Typhoons are the dominant recurring high-impact hazard.
candidates.notes: Core multi-hazard impact series. The Philippines lies on both the typhoon belt and the Pacific Ring of Fire.

candidates.title: PAGASA tropical cyclone and weather monitoring products
candidates.description: Official meteorological agency products on tropical cyclones, rainfall and related hazards. Provides the scientific monitoring backbone for NDRRMC response and early warning.
candidates.notes: Meteorological monitoring node tightly coupled to the disaster cluster.

candidates.title: PEZA ecozone and investment statistics
candidates.description: Statistics on approved investments, employment generation, number of ecozones and export performance under the PEZA regime. Ecozones are a principal vehicle for manufacturing and IT-BPM location.
candidates.notes: Key special-zone and investment-promotion node. Complements the IT-BPM cluster.

candidates.title: Merchandise trade by major partner country
candidates.description: Export and import values by principal trading partners. United States, Japan, China, Hong Kong, Korea and ASEAN partners recur as leading markets and sources; electronics dominate the commodity mix.
referenced_by: National accounts and BOP goods account
candidates.notes: Partner-side densification of the external-trade cluster.

candidates.title: Electronics and semiconductor trade statistics
candidates.description: Trade statistics focused on electronic products — the single largest merchandise export category and a major import category as well, reflecting the country’s role in regional electronics value chains.
candidates.notes: Commodity-specific trade node that links the Philippines into East Asian electronics networks.

candidates.title: Philippines disaster–PEZA–trade densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from NDRRMC, PEZA and PSA trade sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding NDRRMC, disaster impact statistics, PAGASA monitoring, PEZA ecozone/investment performance, merchandise trade by partner, and electronics trade into a coherent risk–investment–trade layer.
referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Earlier regional, IT-BPM and external-sector series
